title: Run of the guessing phase
statement: Let $M$ be a finite deterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, let $d$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$, and let $u,w$ be binary words. Running the guessing-phase machine for $M$ from the invariant configuration corresponding to $(d,u)$ under the choice word $w$ yields the invariant configuration for the configuration reached after $|w|$ steps of $M$ from $d$, with the bits of $w$ selected at the steps when $M$ emits an output symbol appended to $u$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite deterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet
replaced: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine over the binary alphabet, $d$ a configuration, $u$ a captured word and $w$ a word of choice bits. Running the guessing-phase machine of $M$ under $w$ from the invariant configuration for $(d,u)$ yields the invariant configuration for the $|w|$-step run of $M$ from $d$, with the selection of $w$ along the emission mask appended to the captured word.
